import time
import gpiozero
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO
import sys

try:
    # Initialize GPIO with BCM numbering
    GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
    GPIO.setup(2, GPIO.OUT)
    GPIO.setup(3, GPIO.OUT)
    GPIO.setup(4, GPIO.OUT)

    # Initialize gpiozero with BCM numbering
    from gpiozero import LED
    led1 = LED(2)
    led2 = LED(3)
    led3 = LED(4)

    # MQTT client for reporting states
    import paho.mqtt.client as mqtt
    client = mqtt.Client()
    client.on_connect = on_connect
    client.on_message = on_message
    client.connect("mqtt.broker.url", 1883, 60)

    def on_connect(client, userdata, flags, rc):
        print("Connected with result code "+str(rc))
        # Publish the initial state
        client.publish("led_states", "off")
        time.sleep(1)

    def on_message(client, userdata, msg):
        topic = msg.topic
        payload = msg.payload
        if topic == "led_states":
            if payload == "on":
                print("Turning LEDs on")
                led1.on()
                led2.on()
                led3.on()
            else:
                print("Turning LEDs off")
                led1.off()
                led2.off()
                led3.off()

    # Main loop to control LEDs every 60 seconds
    while True:
        try:
            # Check if device is present
            if not GPIO.input(2) == GPIO.HIGH or not GPIO.input(3) == GPIO.HIGH or not GPIO.input(4) == GPIO.HIGH:
                print("Error: One or more LEDs are not connected. Exiting...")
                sys.exit(1)
            # Toggle LED states every 60 seconds
            time.sleep(60)
            if "on" in client.loop():
                print("LED states updated on MQTT broker")
            else:
                print("Failed to update LED states on MQTT broker")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
            sys.exit(1)
        finally:
            # Release GPIO resources
            GPIO.cleanup()

except KeyboardInterrupt:
    print("Program interrupted. Cleaning up GPIO...")
    GPIO.cleanup()

except Exception as e:
    print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

    pc8574 = PCF8574(channel=0)
    print("PCF8574 detected and initialized.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error initializing PCF8574: {e}")
    exit(1)

    print("LCD detected and initialized.")

    print(f"Error initializing LCD: {e}")
    exit(1)

    client = Client("mqtt.example.com", 1883, callback=on_connect)

    print(f"Error connecting to MQTT: {e}")
    exit(1)

        client.disconnect()

import signal

# Function to handle cleanup on exit or interrupt
def cleanup(signum, frame):
    # Release the camera and GPIO resources
    picamera2.stop()
    picamera2.deinit()
    import RPi.GPIO as GPIO
    GPIO.cleanup()

# Main program
def main():
    # Set up GPIO cleanup handler for interrupts
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, cleanup)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, cleanup)

    # Initialize picamera2
    try:
        with picamera2.PiCamera() as camera:
            # Set camera resolution and other settings
            camera.resolution = (640, 480)
            camera.framerate = 10

                # Capture image
                camera.capture('image_{}.jpg'.format(_ + 1))

                # Wait for a short period before capturing the next image
                time.sleep(1)

            print("Image capture completed. Exiting.")

    except picamera2.exc.PiCameraError as e:
        print(f"Error occurred: {e}")

    # Explicitly call cleanup to ensure resources are released
    cleanup(signal.SIGINT, None)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import logging

# Initialize logging for error reporting
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.ERROR)

def read_mpu6050(i2c_bus):
    try:
        # Create I2C bus object
        i2c = smbus.SMBus(i2c_bus)

        # MPU6050 I2C address (0x68)
        ADDRESS = 0x68

        # MPU6050 control register to start measurement (0x1B)
        CTRL_REG1 = 0x1B

        # Mask for single measurement (0x08)
        CTRL_REG1singleMeasurement = 0x08

        # Read the control register to check if measurement is enabled
        if not i2c.read_byte_data(ADDRESS, CTRL_REG1):
            logging.error("Failed to read control register from MPU6050.")
            return

        # Check if measurement is enabled
        if (i2c.read_byte_data(ADDRESS, CTRL_REG1) & CTRL_REG1singleMeasurement) == 0:
            logging.error("Measurement not enabled on MPU6050.")
            return

        # Start measurement
        i2c.write_byte_data(ADDRESS, CTRL_REG1, CTRL_REG1singleMeasurement)

        # Measurement data register (0x3B)
        DATA_REG = 0x3B

        # Read 14 bytes of data (6 bytes for each axis: X, Y, Z, Roll, Pitch, Yaw)
        data = i2c.read_i2c_block_data(ADDRESS, DATA_REG, 14)

        # Convert raw data to readable values
        import mpu6050
        mpu = mpu6050.MPU6050()
        mpu.initialize()
        mpu.read_raw(data)
        orientation = mpu.getOrientation()

        # Print the orientation data
        print("Orientation: ", orientation)

    except Exception as e:
        logging.error(f"Error reading from MPU6050: {e}")
        return 1

    finally:
        # Release the I2C bus
        i2c.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        # Set the I2C bus number (e.g., 1 for Raspberry Pi 3 Model B)
        i2c_bus = 1
        read_mpu6050(i2c_bus)
    except Exception as e:
        logging.error(f"Error executing main: {e}")
        return 1

import logging

# Initialize logging for error tracking
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.ERROR)

# TSL2561 I2C address (0x29 for default configuration)
TSL2561_ADDRESS = 0x29

# TSL2561 registers
REGulator = 0x00  # Register to read the gain settings
TIME_H = 0x01     # Register to read the high time measurement
TIME_L = 0x02     # Register to read the low time measurement

# TSL2561 gain settings
GAIN_0X1 = 0b00  # Gain of 1
GAIN_0X4 = 0b01  # Gain of 4

# Function to read from TSL2561
def read tsl2561(smbus):
    try:
        # Set gain to 1 (GAIN_0X1)
        smbus.write_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDRESS, REGulator, GAIN_0X1)
        time_high = smbus.read_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDRESS, TIME_H)
        time_low = smbus.read_byte_data(TSL2561_ADDRESS, TIME_L)
        lux = calculate_lux(time_high, time_low)
        logging.info(f"Light intensity: {lux} lux")
        return lux
    except smbus.SMBusError as e:
        logging.error(f"Error reading from TSL2561: {e}")
        return None

# Function to calculate lux from TSL2561 readings
def calculate_lux(time_high, time_low):
    # Formula: lux = (time_high * 2^16) / (time_low * 65536) * 100000
    return (time_high * (2**16)) / (time_low * 65536) * 100000

# Main program
def main():
    try:
        # Create I2C bus object
        bus = smbus.SMBus(1)  # Assuming I2C bus is on SMBus 1

        # Read light intensity every second
        while True:
            lux = read tsl2561(bus)
            if lux is not None:
                print(f"Light intensity: {lux} lux")
            time.sleep(1)  # Wait for 1 second

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        # Cleanly exit on interrupt (Ctrl+C)
        logging.info("Program interrupted by user. Cleaning up and exiting.")
        bus.close()

    finally:
        # Release hardware resources on exit
        if bus:
            bus.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        # Read data from registers

        r1_g1_b1 = i2c.read_byte_data(TCS34725_I2C_ADDRESS, TCS34725_REG_R1_G1_B1)
        r2_g2_b2 = i2c.read_byte_data(TCS34725_I2C_ADDRESS, TCS34725_REG_R2_G2_B2)
        r3_g3_b3 = i2c.read_byte_data(TCS34725_I2C_ADDRESS, TCS34725_REG_R3_G3_B3)

        # Perform validity check
        if abs(r0_g0_b0) > VALIDITY_CHECK_THRESHOLD or \
           abs(r1_g1_b1) > VALIDITY_CHECK_THRESHOLD or \
           abs(r2_g2_b2) > VALIDITY_CHECK_THRESHOLD or \
           abs(r3_g3_b3) > VALIDITY_CHECK_THRESHOLD:
            logging.error("Invalid TCS34725 reading: {}".format((r0_g0_b0, r1_g1_b1, r2_g2_b2, r3_g3_b3)))
            return None

        # Convert raw values to lux (approximation)

        lux_r2 = (r2_g2_b2 * 656) / 4096
        lux_r3 = (r3_g3_b3 * 656) / 4096

        return lux_r0, lux_r1, lux_r2, lux_r3

    except Exception as e:
        logging.error("Error reading from TCS34725: {}".format(e))
        return None

    finally:
        # Close I2C bus to release hardware resources
        i2c.close()

        ser = serial.Serial(
            port=DEVICE_NAME,
            baudrate=BAUD_RATE,
            timeout=1  # 1 second timeout to avoid blocking indefinitely
        )
        ser.open()
        print(f"Connected to {DEVICE_NAME} at {BAUD_RATE} baud.")
        return ser

        print(f"Error connecting to {DEVICE_NAME}: {e}")
        return None

            data = ser.readline().strip()

                print("Device did not respond.")
                break
            if not data.startswith('OK'):  # Validity check
                print(f"Invalid reading: {data}")
                continue
            print(f"Received: {data}")
            time.sleep(0.1)  # Wait before next read

        ser.close()
        return

def cleanup(ser):

        ser.close()
        print("Serial port closed.")

def main():

    ser = setup_serial()
    if ser is None:
        print("Device not found.")
        return 1  # Exit non-zero on error

        read_and_handle_data(ser)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        cleanup(ser)
        print("Exiting on interrupt.")

    try:
        # Power control register

        # Read raw data

        y_accel_h = (raw_data[4] << 8) | raw_data[5]
        y_accel_l = (raw_data[6] << 8) | raw_data[7]
        z_accel_h = (raw_data[8] << 8) | raw_data[9]

        gyro_y_h = (raw_data[0] << 8) | raw_data[1]
        gyro_y_l = (raw_data[2] << 8) | raw_data[3]
        gyro_z_h = (raw_data[4] << 8) | raw_data[5]
        gyro_z_l = (raw_data[6] << 8) | raw_data[7]

        # Check for valid accelerometer and gyroscope readings

ACCEL_YOUT_H = 0x3D
ACCEL_YOUT_L = 0x3E
ACCEL_ZOUT_H = 0x3F

GYRO_YOUT_L = 0x44

    try:
        # Power control register
        smbus.write_byte_data(MPU6050_ADDRESS, 0x6B, 0x01)  # Power on

        acc_x_low = smbus.read_i2c_byte(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_XOUT_L)

        acc_y_low = smbus.read_i2c_byte(MPU6050_ADDRESS, ACCEL_YOUT_L)

        # Gyroscope data

        gyro_x_low = smbus.read_i2c_byte(MPU6050_ADDRESS, GYRO_XOUT_L)
        gyro_x = (gyro_x_high << 8) | gyro_x_low
        gyro_y_high = smbus.read_i2c_byte(MPU6050_ADDRESS, GYRO_YOUT_H)

        gyro_z_high = smbus.read_i2c_byte(MPU6050_ADDRESS, GYRO_ZOUT_H)
